Nome: Avalarms
Descrizione: Avalarms (AVALAnche Risk Management System) is a tool to manage the snow avalanche risk in Ebro – Pyrenees BU accesses and assets. It uses public information provided by various administrations that regularly issue avalanche reports informing about the level of hazard, its spatial distribution, and the foreseen avalanche sizes.For all the points that are reachable by avalanches, the release zones of such avalanches are characterized to know their aspects and elevations above the sea level, which will be later compared with those on the avalanche reports.In order to assess whether the avalanche is likely or not to reach the access, each avalanche will be numerically modelized with a specialized software that yields the runout distance of the avalanche according to its size.The tool will determine, according to tailored criteria, whether an access can be used or not and in which conditions, after each new avalanche report release, and will send automatic messages to the concerned staff.
Tipo applicazione: Custom (developed from the scratch)
Stato installazione: Active
Aggiornato da: admin

Nome: Capacity Withholding
Descrizione: Capacity Withholding controls are designed to ensure that market manipulation through power capacity subtraction is not occurring; they are divided into physical and economic withholding controls.
---
Nome: Physical Withholding controls are designed to ensure that bids for each time unit on the MGP market do not deviate from the capacity available for each individual plant.
---
Nome: It is performed on plants enabled for the MGP (excluding aggregate and virtual consumption units) listed in Enel's database.

Nome: Dojo
Descrizione: The goal of the Dojo system is to align users' thinking and practices with continuous improvement, facilitating the adoption and application of Lean principles within the organization. This will be achieved through a technical library that gathers educational resources and a system that guides analyses, initiating a process of standardization. Standardization is a key element of the Lean methodology, as it ensures consistency, efficiency, and quality in processes, reducing variation and improving productivity. The Dojo tool will enable the creation of standard analysis pathways, allowing users to apply common methods and structured approaches to continuously improve business activities. The platform will provide interactive tools to support users in the practical application of Lean concepts, promoting process standardization and fostering a common language across teams.

Descrizione: SAP MM (Materials Management) is a module in SAP ERP Central Component (ECC) that provides companies with materials, inventory and warehouse management capabilities. The primary goal of SAP MM is to make sure that materials are always kept in proper quantities and without shortages or gaps in the organization's supply chain. It also helps supply chain professionals and other SAP users complete the purchasing of goods in a timely and cost-effective way and to be able to deal with day-to-day changes in these processes.

Nome: Equipment
Descrizione: Application for the digital management of the lifecycle of equipment and the safety aspects of its use, under the responsibility of the Local Contact Person who supervises the entire process. It makes it possible to know what equipment exists in a specific Local Unit, the physical warehouse where it is located and the status of the equipment itself. It is possible to census the origin of the equipment, indicate whether it has been checked or not (according to cards with specific checks to be made), assign it a unique code and register it in the local registry. It is also possible to associate an RFID TAG to 'relevant' equipment. There is a mechanism for automatically generating a list of relevant equipment to be checked. The verifications to be carried out are punctually assigned by the local contact person to the operator who is to perform them. The cycle ends when the equipment is decommissioned, and therefore marked as such, always subject to authorisation by the Local Contact Person.
